Temper: Open-source adaptive control plane for coding agents.

Temper supervises coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) by measuring progress, detecting stalls/loops, changing strategy, and verifying outcomes.
It is not another monolithic agent; it sits above them.

Key features:
- TUI (Charmbracelet) and CLI for supervised agent runs.
- Reflex judge (heuristics + optional SLM) for progress evaluation.
- SQLite event store for run history.
- Pluggable LLM providers (Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini).
- Idempotent installer script for easy setup.

Getting started:
- Install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/james-see/temper/main/install.sh | bash
- Or: brew tap james-see/tap && brew install temper
- Or: go install github.com/james-see/temper/cmd/temper@latest
- Run: temper run "your goal"

Development:
- Prerequisites: Go 1.25.0+
- Build: go build -o temper ./cmd/temper
- Test: go test ./...
- See AGENTS.md for detailed contributor guide.

Repository structure:
- cmd/temper: Main CLI application.
- internal/: Core packages (agent, arbiter, config, evaluator, provider, run, store, tui, etc.).
- docs/: Design documents (ARCHITECTURE.md, REFLEX.md, EVENT_MODEL.md, ROADMAP.md).
- site/: Astro-based website (temper.baby).
- examples/: Example configuration files.

Contributing:
- Fork the repo, create a branch, make changes, open a PR.
- Follow Go conventions and coding style.
- Ensure tests pass.
- Update documentation as needed.
- See AGENTS.md for full contribution guidelines.
